title: Shaoyn's First AI Earphones OpenFit 2 AI Makes Debut at Yunqi Conference, Unveils Four New Features from the AI Lab
excerpt: The 2026 Yunqi Conference officially kicked off in Hangzhou, Zhejiang from September 22 to 23. As a leading brand in the open-ear headphone market, Shokz Shaoyi
content_html:
The 2026 Yunqi Conference officially kicked off in Hangzhou, Zhejiang from September 22 to 23. As a leading brand in the open-ear headphone market, Shokz Shaoyin made its debut at the event with great fanfare. The company showcased its first AI-enabled earphone, OpenFit2AI, and jointly launched the new "AI Lab" feature with Guangfan Technology on-site, fully demonstrating the deep industrial application of the Qwen large model in audio wearable devices.

As the pioneering product in Shokz's smart audio strategy, OpenFit2AI deeply integrates the powerful capabilities of the Qwen large model, combining long-duration recording, AI meeting note generation, and multilingual real-time translation. For professional communication scenarios such as finance and law, the product has been optimized for 12 major industries and includes 19 standardized note templates within the official app, significantly enhancing its practical value in business office and high-intensity dialogue scenarios.

The newly launched "AI Lab" at the conference further expands the interaction boundaries of the earphones, introducing four innovative features: intelligent conversation, schedule management, voice notes, and message assistant. Users can easily activate the AI assistant by tapping the earphones, completing tasks such as checking the weather, asking about encyclopedic knowledge, and retrieving information through voice commands. They can also quickly create schedules. Meanwhile, the message assistant can extract key content from long voice messages (such as WeChat messages), and the "Voice Notes" feature allows users to capture inspiration at any time through voice, effectively reducing the frequency of taking out their phones.
